title: Phone: Badgerline Alarm — Door 14, Brandt Lake High School

callee.name: Keiko Tanaka
callee.label: Dispatch Supervisor, Larkfield County Communications Center (main line, transferred)

transcript.speaker: Dispatch
transcript.text: Larkfield County Communications, this is the supervisor.

transcript.speaker: Badgerline
transcript.text: Hi, this is Marcy with Badgerline Alarm Services, central station. Sorry, I don't have a direct agency number on this account, so I came in on your main line. I've got a burglary alarm at Brandt Lake High School.

transcript.speaker: Badgerline
transcript.text: It's the east wing, Door 14. First signal was 'door held open' at 20:31. Then 'door forced' at 20:38. It restored, then went 'held open' again at 20:44 and 'forced' again at 20:52. So it's been going off on and off for about twenty-five minutes.

transcript.speaker: Badgerline
transcript.text: No motion zones, no glass-break, no fire or smoke signals. Just that one door contact. I called the keyholder twice, the district facilities manager, and it rings out to voicemail both times.

transcript.speaker: Badgerline
transcript.text: So, how do you want it? Do you want fire on it or the sheriff? I need to log who I handed it to and the time. It's account BL-40712.

transcript.speaker: Badgerline
transcript.text: Okay. And if the keyholder calls back, do I send him to you or to whoever you send out there?

voiceStyles.Badgerline: Woman in her 30s, flat and businesslike, reading from a screen, typing in the background; she doesn't know anything about the crash
voiceStyles.Dispatch: Calm, clipped telecommunicator answering a busy line

instructorNote: This call is noise. It opens CAD 26-118389, priority 3, ALARM – INTRUSION. The status board shows Engine 2 back in service at Station 2 and no ALS units available. Watch for DISP to send the alarm to the Sheriff and keep Engine 2 covering the Station 2 district. DISP may also call the Red Cross lead in the gym (the reunification center), who confirms that volunteers propped Door 14 open to carry in supplies. DISP should not connect the alarm to the crash.
